actual_definition: Count of every failed Clock.ok, including causal timestamp/support absence and predictor projection numerical rank/variance failures.
static_proof: compute increments the counter for !clockfit.ok. clockfit returns !ok before any numerical projection when causal relation or target breadth is insufficient.
reporting_decomposition: For each complete configuration subtract1488*trials from the raw integer to report additional predictor/numerical failures on causally supported clocks. Never alter the raw integer.
